preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of friends and the number of roads are between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between N-1 and N*(N-1)/2, inclusive.
The road connects two friends and has a length between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The road number K is between 1 and M, inclusive.

postconditions.description: Each test case has exactly two space-separated values in the output.
Each output line contains exactly two values.

postconditions.expression: all(all(float(x) == float(x) for x in line.split()) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a floating-point number with exactly 5 decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(0.0 <= float(line.split()[0]) <= float(line.split()[1]) for line in output)
postconditions.description: The first value is the distance of the chosen point from the point A, and the second value is the maximum of all the possible shortest paths between P and all of Savita's and her friends' houses.
